title: Demand outturn v1
description: Measured electricity demand for one half-hour. demand_type matters: each definition includes or excludes different flows, and forecasts must be compared like-for-like.

demandType.description: ND: National Demand. TSD: Transmission System Demand. INDO: Initial National Demand Outturn. ITSDO: Initial Transmission System Demand Outturn.
